claim: ADR 0291 (fix/recommendations-say-when-and-what, AW01/A-004): the sales_below_weekday_baseline entry takes its urgency from the age of the day it is about, never a literal "now" (2026-10-03 the page said 'Tonight' about Saturday 2026-08-15, 49 days old). salesDipWhen() in apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/recommendations.service.ts bands the age in whole UTC days: 0-1 now, 2-7 (SALES_DIP_WEEK_DAYS) this_week, older or unreadable this_month; only 'now' copy says 'Tonight'. The finder also requires i.category === "sales", so overall.purchase_spend.vs_same_weekday (category purchasing) cannot raise the sales card, and where two sales dips stand (overall.revenue and overall.bottles) freshestSalesDip() restates the one about the newer day (strictly newer; a tie keeps rank), so a stale dip ranked first cannot hide a fresh one. claim: ADR 0291 (AW23/A-024): the generator records vendor.purchase_spend.concentration under the category the catalogue's categorize('vendor','purchase_spend','concentration') returns (purchasing), so the catalogue's narrowed read (CatalogView asks categories=purchasing) finds it instead of printing 'Nothing live for this type right now'. This verify evaluates categorize()'s if-chain from insight-catalog.ts and compares it with the record() literal in insight-generator.service.ts; the general guard is insight-implementations.spec.ts 'every record() files its type under the catalogue's category' (red on 'risk', on a wrong call-site category, and on an unreadable category). INSIGHT_GENERATOR_VERSION 5 (after ADR 0272's 4) retires the v4-and-older risk-filed rows; AW23-2026-10-04-GENERATOR-VERSION-5 checks the bump. Exits 1 against origin/main 8c673db4b.

claim: ADR 0291 (AW23): INSIGHT_GENERATOR_VERSION is at least 5, and its history records version 5 as the 2026-10-04 re-filing of vendor concentration under purchasing, beside ADR 0272's version 4 (#602 took 4 first; this lane was drafted as 4 and renumbered at the merge). So every stored version-4 or older row, which may still hold vendor concentration under risk, is refused and recomputed, never served twice across the purchasing+risk rails.
